task: Binary classification for neuron segment merging
label: binary (1: merge/same neuron, 0: different)
pipeline: EDA -> Preprocess (scale/normalize) -> Handle imbalance (SMOTE/class weights) -> Train (LR, RF, XGB, MLP) -> CV stratified -> Test eval (AUROC, AUPRC, F1, accuracy)
cross_validation: Stratified KFold by label and degradation
